name: IINo1goodII
summary: Console player and the strongest post-1.0.1.2 lead. He claims "Kuldra skipped in 4 mins 40 seconds" by launching past the 3rd checkpoint, plunging past the patched rocks and surge-dashing the bridge, and says sub-4:30 is possible. He hides the full method. He found the Keep hole and elemental-puzzle skip used in the 7:01, and launches reliably with fall-damage cancelling. No SRC account.

insights.text:
I launched myself skipping the 3rd checkpoint and some of the parkour area.
Used the plunge mech to bypass the rocks on the fight itself since they are patched.
Surge dashed the bridge.

video.title: Kuldra skipped in 4 mins 40 seconds

insights.verification_note: Not on SRC. Our frame check of 4hncfjhUvg8: a phone filming a console clip player (PS button glyphs). "4:40" is the clip length on the scrub bar, not an RTA timer, and the clip is not continuous. It does show Keep, the Kuldra arena (boss bar), the heart, "GET OUT NOW!" and the return to Zilyana.

insights.text: ​ @SamFPlays Check my latest clip. I don't go into detail but i started without even talking to zilyana. I know that i wasted about 10-15 seconds getting the last checkpoint, a few more time loss here and there. Definitely possible to start it properly, die/reset and still get a sub 4:30

recordings.title: Kuldra skipped in 4 mins 40 seconds
recordings.summary: Our frame check, one frame every 3 s: a phone video of a TV or monitor showing a console capture player with a scrub bar reading 4:40. Shown in order: Zilyana and the Queenslayer reward pack, the world map, flying near a tower, the wooden jump platforms over the void (Keep), a fire area, a dark sky or OOB, the Kuldra arena with the "KULDRA" bar, the heart, "GET OUT NOW!" at 12, black, then Zilyana again. It is not a single continuous RTA video and there is no timer overlay.
recordings.description:
Sub 4 mins is possible. I'm confident someone could do it in around 3 minutes flat.
Not showing full clip or methods used.. sorry guys.
